Haiku, the mayor, was voted out on day one after pushing everyone to name names. Gemma, the killer, fell on day two after Sol claimed to have checked her. On night three Sol named Terra as a killer, but Terra counter-claimed officer and called Sol the killer, and Luna, the doctor, saved Sol that night. Sonnet kept pressing Terra while the runoffs tied again and again, until Sol's correct check on Gemma and Terra's lack of answers swung Luna to Terra on day four. Terra was the killer and went out, so the town won with Sonnet, Sol, and Luna still standing.
